# Project 50

> Project 50 is a strength and longevity coaching practice in Cheltenham,
> Gloucestershire, UK, founded and led by coach Jo Hucker. It offers 1:1
> coaching, group programmes, digital training, lectures and workshops, and
> tailored youth and senior programmes. The core audience is adults aged 28-55
> who want evidence-led, long-horizon training rather than short transformation
> programmes. "50" refers to decades of capability, not a number of days.

The argument in one line: strength is infrastructure, not spectacle. Training
is programmed from research and elite coaching practice so it holds up for
decades.

## Programmes
- [1:1 Coaching](https://www.project50.uk/programmes.html#coaching): personalised, evidence-led coaching structured around capacity and progression, from rehabilitation to performance.
- [Group Programmes](https://www.project50.uk/programmes.html#group): small structured groups with individual attention, programmed in blocks.
- [Digital Training](https://www.project50.uk/programmes.html#digital): coaching dashboards, data tracking and programming delivered through an online platform, available UK-wide.
- [Lectures & Workshops](https://www.project50.uk/programmes.html#workshops): research-grounded education for schools, organisations, sports clubs and private groups.
- [Youth & Senior Programmes](https://www.project50.uk/programmes.html#youth): age-appropriate coaching from school sport to safe, effective strength training for older adults.

## Founder
Jo Hucker: coaching at Cheltenham Ladies' College, university-level lecturing
at the University of Gloucestershire, elite school sport background. Works with
children, adults, and older adults. [Story](https://www.project50.uk/story.html)

## Who it is for and where
Adults 28-55 (primary), plus youth and senior pathways. Based in Cheltenham,
Gloucestershire; digital programmes available anywhere in the UK.

## FAQ
- What does "50" mean? A horizon, not a countdown: decades of capability, sustained commitment, durable change.
- Do I need to be already fit to start? No; programmes are inclusive by design and adapt to returning exercisers and active athletes alike.
- Is there an online option? Yes; coaching dashboards, structured programmes and tracking through the digital platform.
- How is it different from a personal trainer? Elite sport coaching plus academic rigour and evidence-led programming, refined at Cheltenham Ladies' College and the University of Gloucestershire.
- Strength training for over-50s? Yes; senior programmes adapt for capability and health history without lowering the standard.
- Where? In person in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire; digital coaching UK-wide.
